_note: Twelve industry segments for cross-industry discovery, plus a horizontal 'cross-industry' tag for foundational ontologies. Descriptions are editorial.

items.name: Transportation & Mobility
items.summary: Automotive, rail and mobility systems, including software-defined vehicles.

items.name: Aerospace & Defense
items.summary: Aircraft, space systems and defence programmes driven by systems engineering and certification.

items.name: Marine & Offshore
items.summary: Ships, offshore platforms and process installations at sea.

items.name: Industrial Equipment
items.summary: Machinery, automation, robotics and industrial asset lifecycles.

items.name: High-Tech
items.summary: Electronics, semiconductors, computing, data centres and connected devices.

items.name: Home & Lifestyle
items.summary: Furniture, appliances, smart-home devices and lifestyle products.

items.name: Consumer Packaged Goods & Retail
items.summary: Packaged products, retail, e-commerce and product data exchange.

items.name: Life Sciences & Healthcare
items.summary: Pharma, biotech, medical devices and scientific research.

items.name: Infrastructure, Energy & Materials
items.summary: Power generation and grids, process plants, oil & gas, chemicals and materials.

items.name: Architecture, Engineering & Construction
items.summary: Buildings, facilities, BIM and construction projects.

items.name: Business Services
items.summary: Data management, cataloguing, commerce and knowledge services.

items.name: Cities & Public Services
items.summary: Smart cities, geospatial data, public administration and regulation.

items.name: Cross-Industry
items.summary: Foundational and horizontal ontologies reusable in every industry.
